_comment: Every entity key retired by the global free-tier demotion, pinned against the MEASURED retired-key split: ErrNotFound on the exact-key --by-entity seam for all of them, and ErrNotFound on the looser `show` seam too. The split's two ErrAmbiguous rows (bare `ling` and bare `mimo`) are NOT in this set: neither is a key this lever retires, and both remain live family tokens with live children — turning either into a 404 would break three unrelated live-family lookups. `ling/flash-free@2.6` is likewise absent: it SURVIVES the demotion under an exact-ID pin and is asserted live by the companion test. Each mutation line names where the retired key's instances re-homed; that is the migration record, and it is duplicated in the CHANGELOG table. See TESTING.md.

provenance.ref: the epoch-wide retired-key policy: a retired entity key is a uniform hard 404 on both seams — no alias, no redirect, no successor listing. The CHANGELOG old->new table is the only pointer a user gets.
